notes: Multi Trip maturity QA and architecture cleanup. Service worker no longer hardcodes Okinawa or Bangkok trip data/assets: it now reads the trip registry and each trip config during install, then pre-caches each trip's declared data files and same-origin config assets generically. Bangkok day-gallery rules are consolidated into the single config-declared gallery CSS asset, so future trips can add their own gallery asset without core service-worker edits. Routing remains URL-driven with the Japan trip as the safe default, and existing Live Cam feature gating, trip-scoped checklist sync, Travel Center date sorting and generic renderers are retained.
